e: Borrowed from Hindustani, from Classical Persian نَظِیر (nazīr), from Arabic نَظِير (naẓīr).
Borrowed from Urdu ناظم, ultimately from Arabic ناظم.
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish نظر (now Turkish nazar (boncuğu)), from Arabic نَظَر (naẓar).
Borrowed from Georgian ნაზუქი (nazuki), possibly related to Նազուկ (Nazuk).
From Old English næs; cognate with Icelandic nes, Swedish näs, Danish næs. Related to ness.
